# Gain-map reader fixtures

These small fixtures were generated locally for the `JxlGainMapBundle` API
tests. Four `.jhgm` payloads use the JPEG XL bundle writer and a clean
libultrahdr metadata encoder at commit
`418b6b361e252a91c435a56cf386afb37d7d1c9d`. The structured field is linear
sRGB; the ICC field is the 536-byte profile generated by the existing jxl-rs
color API. The gain-map image is a lossless 2x2 RGB JXL image with unequal
channels and is included both as a naked codestream and as a small JXL
container. `want_icc.jhgm` is a manually assembled envelope whose field
retention was checked with the reference bundle reader. `synthetic-container.jxl`
is an outer container with a finite
trailing `jhgm` box.

No fixture contains applied gain-map rendering. Tests verify envelope fields,
color/ICC decoding, nested 8-bit RGB image dimensions and exact samples, and
malformed bounds only.
